about_section: No special talents. Just passionately curious.

recent_posts.text: Introducing Patterno AI – built to turn market signals into fast, smart decisions. As Founder's Associate at Patterno AI, I've had the chance to contribute directly to launching a SaaS-product that tackles one of the biggest challenges in enterprise today: data overload and decision latency. We transform external data, from commodity prices and news to geopolitical risks and regulations into auditable, €-quantified, and actionable recommendations.
While on our Investment Banking Tour to Frankfurt, we will also be visiting KKR. We'll dive into several case studies on topics like Private Equity, Real Estate and Private Markets / Fundraising.

background: Corporate strategy at major logistics company (Hapag-Lloyd)
